{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}


::: {#exr-crow-mean-bed}
Using computer notation, show how to set up a function that computes the finite-difference rate of change of a function. 

```r
df <- function(f, x, h = 1e-5) {   
  (f(x + h) - f(x)) / h
}   

# Now have it return a function
deriv <- function(f, h = 1e-5) {
  function(x) {
    df(f, x, h)
  }
}

# Show how to use these two different forms.

```


Have students explore it at different step sizes. (Maybe ask them to look for regions where the function is approximately flat.)

THAT RAISES THE QUESTION OF WHAT APPROXIMATELY FLAT MEANS. The second derivative is very small. WITH RESPECT TO WHAT?
:::
